'''Pact''' is the groups-and-clubs surface of the [[Pentecaust]] messaging layer, published at pact.pentecaust.com. Where [[Pentecaust]] provides direct messaging between accounts, Pact is its companion for group spaces — clubs and communities rather than one-to-one conversation.

== Function ==
* Group spaces and clubs, as the persistent multi-person unit alongside Pentecaust's direct messages.
* The same single sign-in identity used across the other ecosystem surfaces, so one [[MELEK Blockchain|MELEK]] account carries a user into Pact as well.
